# Curases — Agentic Custom Cursor Engine for the Web

> Curases (https://curases.com) is a zero-dependency, ultra-lightweight custom cursor engine designed for modern web applications and AI coding agents. It provides physics-based cursor motion, automatic state detection (hover, click, typing, drag, resize, not-allowed), and designer-grade SVG cursor styles across any framework.

## Key Capabilities
- **Universal Compatibility**: Works with Vanilla HTML, Next.js (App & Pages Router), React, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Webflow, Shopify, WordPress, and more.
- **Physics & Smoothing**: Smooth interpolation (`speed` multiplier from `0.1` to `1.0`), dynamic scaling (`size` multiplier), and color tinting (`color` hex/rgb).
- **Auto State Detection**: Automatically responds to `<a>`, `<button>`, `input[type="text"]`, `textarea`, `[draggable]`, disabled elements, and custom `[data-cursor-state]`.
- **Zero Layout Shift & High Performance**: Hardware-accelerated GPU transforms (`translate3d`), passive listeners, zero external runtime dependencies.

---

## 1-Minute Quickstart

### Option 1: Universal CDN Script Tag (Any HTML / CMS / Framework)
Place this tag in the `<head>` or at the end of `<body>`:
```html
<script 
  src="https://curases.com/engine.js" 
  data-cursor="Handy" 
  data-size="1.0" 
  data-speed="1.0" 
  data-color="#3b82f6"
  defer>
</script>
```

### Option 2: Next.js (App Router `layout.tsx`)
```tsx
import Script from "next/script";

export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <head>
        <Script
          src="https://curases.com/engine.js"
          strategy="afterInteractive"
          data-cursor="Handy"
          data-size="1.0"
          data-speed="1.0"
        />
      </head>
      <body>{children}</body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

### Option 3: React / Vite / SPA
```tsx
import { useEffect } from "react";

export function CustomCursor() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const script = document.createElement("script");
    script.src = "https://curases.com/engine.js";
    script.setAttribute("data-cursor", "Handy");
    script.setAttribute("data-size", "1.0");
    script.setAttribute("data-speed", "1.0");
    script.defer = true;
    document.body.appendChild(script);

    return () => {
      script.remove();
      window.Curases?.hide();
    };
  }, []);

  return null;
}
```

---

## Script Attributes & Parameters
- `data-cursor`: Name of the cursor pack (`"Handy"`). Case-insensitive.
- `data-size`: Unitless scale factor (`1.0` = default 32x32px). There is no fixed pixel measurement to drift across zoom or DPI; increase it for a larger cursor.
- `data-speed`: Lag/inertia factor between `0.1` (heavy smooth trail) and `1.0` (instant real-time tracking).
- `data-color`: Hex (`#00ffcc`) or RGB (`rgb(0, 255, 204)`) color override. Omit to preserve designer SVG fills.
- `data-roughness`: Hand-drawn path roughness (`0` = clean/solid lines, `0.5` = subtle pen wobble, `2.0` = maximum sketchy wobble). Paths are re-drawn with seeded per-point jitter.
- `data-boil`: Animated sketch flicker from `0` (static sketch) to `1.0` (maximum boil). Defaults to `0.3`.
- `data-edge-dive`: Predictive edge-dive / magnetic capture (`"true"` default). Set `"false"` to disable.
- `data-edge-buffer`: Virtual dive horizon inset from the raw edge in px (default `18`). The cursor reaches `scale = 0` here before the pointer hits the border.
- `data-edge-outer-margin`: Outer prediction zone in px from the raw edge (default `48`).
- `data-edge-magnetic-radius`: Inner magnetic capture well in px from the raw edge (default `32`).
- `data-edge-magnetic-strength`: Multiplier for the ease-out magnetic lead curve (default `1.0`).
- `data-edge-exit-threshold`: Velocity toward an edge, in px/ms, for full exit confidence (default `0.35`).
- `data-edge-margin`: Legacy alias for the outer prediction zone (default `28`).
- `data-edge-lookahead`: Velocity projection time in ms (default `42`).
- `data-edge-scope`: Optional CSS selector for a scoped container boundary. The cursor is clipped to the container while inside it.
- `data-hide-native`: `"true"` (default) automatically hides the native OS cursor using CSS. Set `"false"` to keep native cursor visible.

---

## JavaScript Runtime API (`window.Curases`)
When the script is loaded, `window.Curases` exposes:
- `Curases.load(cursorId)`: Switch cursor pack on the fly (e.g. `Curases.load("Handy")`).
- `Curases.setSize(number)`: Change cursor size multiplier.
- `Curases.setSpeed(number)`: Adjust smoothing factor (`0.1` - `1.0`).
- `Curases.setColor(string)`: Override color tint.
- `Curases.setRoughness(number)`: Live-update the hand-drawn sketch roughness (`0` - `2`).
- `Curases.setBoil(number)`: Live-update the boil flicker amount (`0` = static, `1` = max).
- `Curases.setEdgeDive(value)`: Toggle predictive edge dive (`false`) or tune `{ edgeBuffer, outerMargin, magneticRadius, magneticStrength, exitThreshold, autoSuppressFlushSides, edges, wallBump, wallBumpIntensity, lookahead, scope, stiffness, damping }`. When bounds fill the viewport width, left/right are auto-suppressed by default and produce a tactile wall-bump on fast impact.
- `Curases.state(string)`: Force a specific state (`"hover"`, `"typing"`, `"drag"`, `"normal"`).
- `Curases.hide()` / `Curases.show()`: Toggle cursor visibility.

Add the script cleanly to the root layout or index.html and ensure native cursor hiding does not conflict with input text selection."

## Full Documentation & Specifications
For complete technical schemas, state vectors, and REST endpoints, visit:
- Full Spec: https://curases.com/llms-full.txt
- Registry API: https://curases.com/api/registry
- Cursors Manifest: https://curases.com/cursors/manifest.json
- Cursor Asset API (public, CORS-enabled): https://curases.com/api/cursors/{file}
